description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PasswordValidationPolicyNotFoundException' used when password validation policies are not found in the system. It extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' and provides multiple constructors for different scenarios.

classes.name: PasswordValidationPolicyNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException thrown when a password validation policy resource is not found.

methods.name: PasswordValidationPolicyNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs exception indicating a password validation policy with a specific ID does not exist.

methods.name: PasswordValidationPolicyNotFoundException()
methods.description: Constructs exception indicating no active password validation policy was found.

methods.name: PasswordValidationPolicyNotFoundException(EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs exception wrapping an underlying data access exception indicating no password validation policy was found.
